svg.text: Google Merchandise Store web analytics, GA4 sample (2020-11-01 to 2021-01-31)

Rendered from results/tables (SQL on DuckDB, full data: 4,295,584 events, 360,129 sessions). Session = user_pseudo_id + ga_session_id; bounce = not engaged (GA4); conversion = session with a purchase (revenue > 0).
